        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

from collections import Counter, deque
def comps_of(I,bg):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                comp=[(r,c)]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c))
                while q:
                    rr,cc=q.popleft()
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and I[nr][nc]!=bg and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                            seen.add((nr,nc)); comp.append((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
                out.append(comp)
    return out
def tpl_cells(I,O,cells):
    vals=tuple(I[r][c] for r,c in sorted(cells))
    h=max(r for r,c in cells)-min(r for r,c in cells)+1
    w=max(c for r,c in cells)-min(c for r,c in cells)+1
    sh=[[I[min(r for r,c in cells)+i][min(c for r,c in cells)+j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    return sh,h,w,tuple(vals)
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I=G[nm+' input']; O=G[nm+' output']
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells_=_=[list(map(tuple,v)) for v in []]
    mks=[(r,c) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if cnt[I[r][c]]<20]
    mkv=I[mks[0][0]][mks[0][1]]
    big=max(comps_of(I,bg),key=len)
    bigv=sorted((I[r][c] for r,c in big))
    # cells of big excluding those equal to marker val if overlapping
    cells=[(r,c) for r,c in big if I[r][c]!=mkv]
    sh,h,w,vals=tpl_cells(I,O,cells)
    pos=[(mr,mc,min((abs(r-mr)+abs(cc-mc),r,cc) for r in range(len(O)) for cc in range(len(O[0])) if any(sh[i][j]==O[r][cc] for j in range(w) for i in range(h)))>2)) for mr,mc in mks][:4]
    print(nm,'bg',bg,'mkval',mkv,'big vals',bigv,'sh=',sh,'h,w=',h,w,'nmarks',len(mks),'first marks:',mks[:4])

def comps_of(I,bg):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); seen=set(); out=[]

G=load()
def f(I,O,nm):
    Hh,Ww=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(Hh):
        for c in range(Ww):
            if I[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                comp=[(r,c)]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c))
                while q:
                    rr,cc=q.popleft()
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                        if 0<=nr<Hh and 0<=nc<Ww and I[nr][nc]!=bg and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                            seen.add((nr,nc));comp.append((nr,nc));q.append((nr,nc))
                comps.append(comp)
    big=max(comps,key=lambda cs:len(cs))
    hh=len(big)+max(len(cs)-1 for cs in comps if cs!=big) or len(big)
    minr=min(r for r,c in big); minc=min(c for r,c in big)
    # bbox
    rs=[r for r,_ in big]; cs=[c for _,c in big]
    h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(c for c in cs)+1
    sil=[[P[i][j]!=bg for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    mks=sorted[(co for co in comps if len(co)==1)]
    mks=tuple([list(s) for s in mks])
    out=True; bad=[]
    for mr,mc in mks:
        ah,hf=(h-1)//2; aw,wf=(w-1)//2
        r0,c0=(mr-ah,mc-aw)
        ok=all(0<=r0+i<Hh and 0<=c0+j<Ww and sil[i][j]==O[r0+i][c0+j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w))
        if ok: pass
